Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

I'm happy · Yes, I am / No, I'm not
QuestionYesNo
Are you tired?Yes, I am.No, I'm not.
Is he OK?Yes, he is.No, he isn't.
Are they busy?Yes, they are.No, they aren't.
  • Feelings: I'm + adjective. I'm happy. She's tired. We're busy.
  • Short answer: Yes, I am. (NOT “Yes, I'm”.) No, I'm not.
  • Match the verb: Are you…? → I am. Is he…? → he is. Are they…? → they are.
  • Be polite: How are you? — I'm fine, thanks.

→ can (I can swim) comes in Lesson 16.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: Are you tired? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Repeat the little verb, not the whole sentence.
  • ⚠ Don't answer just 'Yes' — English repeats the verb: Yes, I am (да → Yes, I am).

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two short lines: how you feel, and ask a question.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

I'm happy today! I'm a bit tired, too. How are you?

Check yourself:

  • Did you use I'm + a feeling?
  • Did you ask How are you? / And you?
  • Is the short answer right? (Yes, I am — not “Yes, I'm”)
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi! I'm Sam. 👋

Sam

How are you today?

Sam

Good! 😊

Sam

Are you tired?

Sam

OK! 🙂

Sam

Listen: someone says “Are you cold? Yes, I'm.” 🤔

Why

Short answer is “Yes, I am”, never “Yes, I'm”. And “No, I'm not”.

Sam

Yes! “Yes, I am.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you said how you feel and fixed the short answer. Next time, say it out loud too.
